data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu made 72 GitHub contribution-count commits, all on UTMIST/Misty, across 22 pushes. He opened pull requests UTMIST/Misty#293, #294, #307, #308, #309, #311, #314, #316, #318, and #319, and reviewed pull requests on UTMIST/Misty and UTMIST/UTMIST, including UTMIST/UTMIST#487. He also opened issues on UTMIST/Misty (#291, #292, #301, #302, #315) and UTMIST/UTMIST#495.
